name: asi-backend
description: Local-first ASI V1 modular monolith backend and control plane

scripts.lint: eslint backend/server.js backend/app.js backend/config backend/controllers backend/database backend/middlewares backend/routes backend/services backend/src backend/utils scripts
scripts.test: npm run build:internal && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.admin --test backend/tests/*.test.js backend/tests/models/*.test.js backend/tests/stage02/*.test.js
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:internal && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.admin --test backend/tests/http-foundation.test.js backend/tests/lifecycle.test.js backend/tests/migration-relocation.test.js backend/tests/models/all-models.test.js backend/tests/stage02/database-unit.test.js
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:internal && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.admin --test backend/tests/database.test.js backend/tests/api-parity.test.js backend/tests/identity-integration.test.js backend/tests/stage02/postgres-integration.test.js
scripts.test:product: npm run build:internal && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.admin --test backend/tests/product-integration.test.js backend/tests/repository-snapshot.test.js
scripts.test:providers: npm run build:internal && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.admin --test backend/tests/provider-unit.test.js backend/tests/provider-integration.test.js backend/tests/provider-http.test.js backend/tests/provider-contract.test.js
